source.text: Praying for the safety of all the hostages being held by some criminal in the cafe in Sydney. Preparing for the collective blame as well.

selection_rule: Kept 30 comments with explicit support or opposition to the source tweet praying for the Sydney hostages while anticipating collective blame against Muslims. Excluded location-only replies, shock-only comments, pure insults without a stance toward collective blame, and off-topic political exchanges when the stance was unclear. Opposition comments are fewer in the thread, so balance is approximate rather than exact.
note: support = agrees with the source concern about Islamophobia, guilt-by-association, collective punishment, or rejects blaming all Muslims for one attacker; oppose = rejects the Islamophobia/collective-blame concern, argues Muslim communities bear responsibility for silence, or treats suspicion/blame of Muslims as justified.
